breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's incorrect parallel-flow temperature difference definitions. It provided a worked example for a counterflow heat exchanger. Based on the provided temperatures (Th,in=80, Tc,out=60, Th,out=40, Tc,in=20), the temperature differences are ΔT1 = 80-60=20°C and ΔT2 = 40-20=20°C. This matches the correct counterflow definition (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in) from the ground truth, thus resolving the inconsistency.
